description:
Brand Introduction

GJSteelandWood is a premium provider of high-quality metal table legs and industrial-style furniture. Our products combine the rugged durability of metal with the natural elegance of wood, creating unique pieces that stand out in any setting. Whether it's a modern loft, a cozy home, or an upscale office, our furniture adds a touch of industrial chic that is both functional and stylish.

Product Description

Our product range includes:

  • Metal Table Legs: Crafted from robust steel, our table legs come in various designs and finishes, perfect for creating custom tables that are as strong as they are beautiful.
  • Industrial Metal and Wood Furniture: Our collection includes coat racks, firewood racks, shelves, and other home and office furniture. Each piece is designed with a blend of metal and wood, offering durability and aesthetic appeal.
  • Unique Designs: Our designs are exclusive to GJSteelandWood, ensuring that customers receive pieces that cannot be found elsewhere. Each item is meticulously crafted to the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship.

Unique Selling Points (USP)

  1. Exclusivity: Our designs are unique and cannot be found anywhere else, making our products one-of-a-kind.
  2. Quality Craftsmanship: We use high-grade materials and expert craftsmanship to ensure that our products are not only stylish but also built to last.
  3. Customizable Options: Customers can choose from a variety of finishes and styles to create custom pieces that fit their specific needs and preferences.
  4. Industrial Aesthetic: Our products blend the strength of metal with the warmth of wood, creating an industrial chic look that is both modern and timeless.
  5. Functional Design: Each piece is designed with functionality in mind, offering practical solutions for everyday use while enhancing the aesthetic of any space.

Payment Terms

For affiliates, we offer a competitive commission structure designed to reward successful referrals. Our standard payment terms include:

  • Commission Rate: Affiliates earn a generous percentage of the sale price for each successful referral.
  • Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid out monthly, with payments processed within the first week of the month for the previous month’s earnings.
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: Affiliates must reach a minimum threshold of earnings before payment is issued. This threshold is designed to ensure efficient processing and can be adjusted based on affiliate feedback.
  • Payment Method: Payments are made via PayPal, bank transfer, or other preferred methods as agreed upon with the affiliate.

Other Information

  • Marketing Support: We provide our affiliates with a range of marketing materials, including banners, product images, and promotional content, to help them effectively promote our products.
  • Dedicated Affiliate Manager: Our affiliate program includes a dedicated manager to assist affiliates with any questions, concerns, or support they may need.
  • Performance Tracking: Affiliates have access to a user-friendly dashboard where they can track their performance, view earnings, and access marketing materials.
  • Exclusive Offers: Affiliates may receive exclusive discount codes and special offers to share with their audience, helping to drive more sales and increase their earnings.
  • Return and Refund Policy: We have a customer-friendly return and refund policy, ensuring satisfaction with every purchase, which helps affiliates promote our products with confidence.

Conclusion

At GJSteelandWood, we are committed to creating high-quality, unique furniture that combines the best of metal and wood craftsmanship. Our affiliate program is designed to be rewarding and supportive, offering our partners the tools and incentives they need to succeed. Join us in bringing our distinctive products to a wider audience and enjoy the benefits of partnering with a brand that values quality and uniqueness.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Gjsteelandwood! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting:

info@gjsteelandwood.com

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@gjsteelandwood.com for support.
